title: Austin Sues Houston Lighting & Power
summary:
*   Austin city leaders held a special, closed-door emergency meeting.
*   The entire session focused exclusively on discussing pending legal action.
*   Key litigation involved the City of Austin against Houston Lighting and Power Company.
*   No public votes or policy decisions were announced during this meeting.
